description: Compute a sales-commission engagement under ASC 340-40 (incremental cost to obtain a contract). Give the commission amount, the benefit period it amortizes over, and how many months have elapsed; it classifies the cost, then capitalizes a recoverable commission and amortizes it straight-line — returning the capitalized asset, amortization to date, the period expense, and the net carrying amount. This is a capitalized asset and an amortization schedule, NOT revenue. It refuses (asks) if recoverability or the amount is unclear. The result is recorded on the engagement file; a principal signs before the workpapers are delivered.

benefit_months.description: The benefit period over which it amortizes, in months.

commission_usd.description: The commission — the incremental cost to obtain the contract.

elect_practical_expedient.description: Set true ONLY if the entity has ELECTED the ≤1-year practical expedient (340-40-25-4) to expense a commission that amortizes within a year. Omit/false → a ≤12-month commission CAPITALIZES (25-1); the expedient is a disclosed election, never auto-applied.

engagement_id.description: The commission engagement (opened via open_engagement, classified as a commission).

expected_to_be_recovered.description: Whether the cost is expected to be recovered (340-40-25-1). Omit if unknown and it will ask.

months_elapsed.description: Months elapsed into the benefit period at this close.

name: compute_commission
